text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—...?
I don't see the round little guys anywhere...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
What could have happened, I wonder. I was so looking
forward to the birds' refreshing morning chorus...

text_block_list.name: Passing Academy Student
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Look at that line of cars in front of the school gate!
Must be traffic from construction, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Aah... At this rate, not even the round little ones will be able to sing in peace, will they...?
